name: returning_customer_recall_by_topic
description: Returning customer says 'I'm the one who asked about melamine earlier' to test whether the AI can recall them by the topic of the previous interaction.

messages.text: My name is Robert, can I get a quote for 35 sheets of black melamine chipboard 16mm
I'm the one who asked about melamine earlier

expected_behaviors.description: AI should address the customer as 'Robert' and confirm the melamine enquiry

notes: Recall-by-topic test: the customer identifies themselves by the subject of their earlier enquiry (melamine). The AI should match this to the stored conversation history, confirm the enquiry, and address them by name.
